name: nasa-power-mcp-server
description: Query NASA POWER solar, wind, building, and agroclimatology data via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

interface.shortDescription: Query NASA POWER solar, wind, building, and agroclimatology data via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.
interface.longDescription: Retrieve NASA POWER hourly, daily, monthly and climatological observations for points, bounded regions and labeled location comparisons. Discover community-specific parameter codes and presets, preserve source units and missing values, and inspect provenance and period-aware summaries. Small results return inline; larger datasets stage completely in DuckDB for explicit-token, read-only SQL. No NASA account or API key is required.
